name: 319-box-kind-create
description: Issue 319 design-correction follow-on: demonstrates create_box and connect as LANGUAGE-AGNOSTIC BOX KINDS rather than per-language wrappers. A read box emits a box spec on its wire; a create_box-kind box consumes the spec and emits the new box's id; the id is captured downstream. Same shape works for any language — no per-language wrapper needed.
